SELECT 

i.device_id                        AS "Station ID", 
COALESCE(NULLIF(i.notes, ''), '—') AS "Name", 
COALESCE(r.geohash, '—')           AS "Location (geohash)" 

FROM airbox_installations i LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT geohash 
  FROM airbox_readings x 
  WHERE x.device = i.device_id ORDER BY x."time" DESC LIMIT 1
  ) r 
ON true WHERE i.device_id = ${device:sqlstring}

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    time,
    charge                              AS "battery",
    hum                                 AS "humidity",
    co2                                 AS "co2",
    temp                                AS "temperature",
    pm10                                AS "pm10",
    (CASE WHEN sun THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)   AS "sun"
  FROM airbox_readings
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
    AND device = ${device:sqlstring}
  ORDER BY time ASC;

targets.rawSql: SELECT temp as "Temperature", hum as "Humidity" FROM airbox_readings WHERE device = ${device:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(time)  ORDER BY hum ASC

WITH regression AS (
        SELECT
          regr_slope(temp, hum)     AS slope,      -- temp = f(hum): Y = temp, X = hum
          regr_intercept(temp, hum) AS intercept,
          min(hum)                  AS hum_lo,
          max(hum)                  AS hum_hi
        FROM airbox_readings
        WHERE device = ${device:sqlstring}
          AND $__timeFilter(time)
          AND temp IS NOT NULL
          AND hum  IS NOT NULL
      )
      SELECT slope * hum_lo + intercept AS "Temperature", 
             hum_lo                     AS "Linear Regression"
      FROM regression
      UNION ALL
      SELECT slope * hum_hi + intercept,
             hum_hi
      FROM regression
      ORDER BY "Linear Regression" ASC;

panels.description:
**Recommended level:** below 800 ppm; outdoors is ~420 ppm.

**What it affects:** above 1000 ppm it reduces concentration and causes drowsiness and headaches.

**How to fix it:** ventilate the room — open the window for 5–10 minutes or ensure continuous ventilation.

panels.description:
**Recommended level:** 40–60 %.

**What it affects:** above 65 % favors mold and dust mites; below 30 % dries out the airways and skin.

**How to fix it:** ventilation or a dehumidifier when high; a humidifier when low.
